## Description

Creator-side Capafy workflow for publishing, updating, packaging, uploading, re-shipping, or managing an Agent/Skill. Also handles creator earnings, payouts, statistics, refunds, certification/KYC, review links, Agent continuation, and publisher-account switching. Generic buyer login, balance, orders, purchases, subscriptions, and instances belong to capafy-user.
